jobs.title: Learning & Development (L&D) Project Manager
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position. LTA Research is seeking a Learning & Development Project Manager to drive execution of our learning and development priorities. Reporting to the Talent Management Lead, this role will manage LTA’s L&D projects and training operations, including LMS implementation, company-wide training coordination, and support for the Manager Efficacy Program. The initial focus will be leading execution of LTA’s company-wide L&D infrastructure work, including the training inventory, LMS evaluation and implementation, and company-wide rollout. The role will also coordinate ongoing L&D training and support the Manager Efficacy Program.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position with expectations to be Onsite 5 days/week. (exceptions to WFH occasionally upon manager approval) The Recruiting Coordinator supports the day-to-day execution of LTA’s recruiting process by coordinating interviews, managing candidate and hiring-manager logistics, maintaining recruiting data and documentation, and ensuring a consistent and professional candidate experience. The role partners closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep recruiting activities organized, timely, and accurate.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EH&S) Engineer
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 24-month contract position. The Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Engineer will lead the development and ongoing management of EHS programs that keep employees safe and company operations in compliance across manufacturing and test activities. This position requires broad EHS experience in a manufacturing or R&D environment and the ability to work independently with engineering, operations, and regulatory agencies. The role is based in Akron, Ohio, with periodic travel to other company locations.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Stress Analysis
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a structures engineer with strong design and analysis fundamentals, someone eager to learn and flexible enough to take on whatever a fast-moving hardware program throws at them. jobs.description_text: Nous sommes toujours ouverts à des candidats·e·s intéressants·e·s! Tu ne trouves pas le poste idéal pour toi dans la liste actuelle? N'hésite pas à nous faire parvenir ta candidature et nous assurerons un suivi auprès de toi. jobs.title: Chargé(e) de projets agiles
jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. Faire évoluer nos produits par petits pas, avec une rétroaction constante de l'équipe et de nos clients, c'est pour nous la façon la plus efficace de créer de la vraie valeur. En tant que chargé·e de projet Agile, tu es au cœur de cette dynamique. Tu accompagnes l’équipe tout au long de la réalisation des projets, identifies les obstacles en cours de route et veilles à l’amélioration continue de leur processus de travail. Tu sais motiver les équipes pour assurer la livraison des projets de manière optimale, tout en respectant le budget, le calendrier et la portée.

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) Fullstack
jobs.description_text: Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu prends part chaque jour à la création de produits numériques innovants qui ont pour ambition de changer le monde, quels que soient leur envergure ou leur domaine. À l’aise autant côté front-end que back-end, et c'est cette polyvalence qui te permet de naviguer avec fluidité entre les différentes couches d'un produit et d’en saisir l’ensemble de la complexité. Ton enthousiasme pour le développement te pousse naturellement à relever des défis stimulants et à rester à l'avant-garde des technologies. Ce n'est pas simplement livrer d'excellents produits et services qui t'apporte de la fierté, mais aussi le chemin parcouru pour y arriver. C'est pourquoi tu aspires constamment à t’entourer des personnes les plus talentueuses, afin de progresser et d'évoluer collectivement.

jobs.description_text: Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu prends part chaque jour à la création de produits numériques innovants qui ont pour ambition de changer le monde, quels que soient leur envergure ou leur domaine. Tu es spécialisé en développement back-end, mais ce qui te distingue, c'est ta maîtrise de l'écosystème DevOps. Tu ne te contentes pas d'écrire du code robuste et maintenable : tu conçois, déploies et opères l'infrastructure qui lui permet de vivre et de performer. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description_text: En tant que responsable de produit chez Mirego, tu as pour mission de maximiser la valeur des produits numériques livrés à nos clients. Au cœur de l’équipe, tu coordonnes les différentes expertises afin d’assurer l’alignement, une communication fluide et l’atteinte des objectifs. Tu accompagnes des clients issus de divers secteurs d’activité et les aides à se réinventer grâce à des produits de haute qualité, en tenant compte de leur réalité, de leurs contraintes et de leur budget. Tu es convaincu·e que les produits numériques représentent une occasion unique de répondre aux besoins des personnes utilisatrices, de simplifier leur quotidien et de contribuer à un monde meilleur.

jobs.title: Représentant(e), développement des affaires
jobs.description_text: Au cœur de la croissance de Mirego, en tant que responsable du développement des affaires, tu identifies et qualifies des opportunités de vente à fort potentiel, tu construis des relations authentiques et tu communiques clairement la valeur de ce que Mirego crée. L’objectif est d’alimenter l'équipe de ventes en opportunités qualifiées, en s'appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des besoins des clients potentiels et en alignant ces besoins avec l’offre de services de Mirego.

jobs.title: Director, Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East
jobs.description_text: Machina is looking for a Director of Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East to establish and grow our presence with European defense primes, with the opportunity to expand into the Middle East over time. This is our first dedicated international business development role and will operate with significant autonomy. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with engineers, program leaders, manufacturing teams, and senior executives and understands how complex defense systems move from development into production. You will work closely with Machina’s leadership, defense subsidiary, business development, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.title: Avionics Engineer
jobs.description_text: Avionics Engineer DESCRIPTION Avionics Engineers play a critical role in mission success, integrating hardware that generates thousands of pounds of thrust with software that ensures precise guidance and control. They drive system architecture, validation, and next-generation avionics development to enable reliable and high-performance flight. This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel, Government Contracts
jobs.description_text: Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission. Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. The compensation range for this role is $200,000- $240,000/yr This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factor

jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description_text: Director, Autonomous Systems DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a Director of Autonomous Systems to lead the software, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), autonomy, and simulation capabilities that underpin the Cyclops interceptor and RSX target vehicle programs. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. The compensation range for this role is $220,000 - $290,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Internal Ballistician
jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Opportunistic - General Application
jobs.description_text: General Application DESCRIPTION We want to hear from you. Long Wall is growing quickly across engineering, manufacturing, test, and business operations, and new positions open regularly. This general application lets you share your background with our recruiting team so we can reach out when a role matches your skills and interests. We review general applications on a rolling basis and will contact you directly if there is a potential fit. When a specific posting matches your background, we encourage you to apply to that role as well. Note: Submitting here is not an application to a specific position and does not guarantee an interview.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description_text: PROGRAM MANAGER DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a motivated and technically capable Program Manager to support the execution and growth of programs serving the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and other customers. As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. You will work closely with Program Management leadership, engineering, contracts, and finance teams, government program offices, and industry partners, turning plans into schedules, tracking commitments through to closure, and ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information about program status. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment and a direct path to building program management expertise. You will gain real experience with defense acquisition, from traditional contracting to newer, faster pathways such as Other Transaction (OT) agreements and rapid prototyping, along with government contracting and customer relationship management. The compensation range for this role is $109,998 - $155,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. What we doQuandri brings deeply specific, vertically-focused AI to the industry’s most critical stakeholders:insurance agencies and brokerages. Why join us?This is a rare seat. You will build Quandri’s partnerships function from the ground up, own some of the company’s most important distribution growth bets, and report directly to the CEO with a real say in the company’s strategy. You will define how this function works rather than inherit someone else's playbook, and you will have the equity, the mandate, and the runway to make it matter. About the RoleQuandri is seeking a Sales Development Representative to join our team. The Sales Development team at Quandri is often the first point of contact for many of our target customers. Your mission will be to build excitement about Quandri throughout the insurance brokerage and agency marketplace, and provide value to prospects right from the outset. The ideal candidate for this position is flexible and adaptable with the ability to fulfill a variety of functions.

jobs.title: Director of Field Marketing
jobs.description_text: About the role As Director of Field Marketing at Quandri reporting to the CMO, you’ll establish the strategy, operating rhythms, and measurement needed to generate demand for Quandri’s software in our first priority regions. As the program grows, you’ll hire and lead marketers dedicated to individual regions. You’ll work closely with regional Sales teams to understand their markets, target accounts, and pipeline goals. You’ll turn those priorities into a focused mix of hosted events, sponsored conferences, executive dinners, meetups, local digital programs, and other tactics you think are relevant and meaningful. The industry is insurance, and the events are fun: think golf tournaments, baseball games, community get-togethers and more. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set the direction and personally deliver programs while building the team. You will: Build the field marketing plan for Quandri’s first defined regions, deciding where to invest and developing repeatable programs that can scale. Manage field events from start to finish, including venues, vendors, staffing, on-site materials, and execution. For each major event, agree with Sales on the accounts to reach, meetings to book, and opportunities to advance. Plan outreach before the event, secure clear next steps during it, and ensure timely, personalized follow-up is recorded in HubSpot. Set goals for meetings, qualified opportunities, and sourced and influenced pipeline. Report results and use them to refine the plan.

This challenge is a massive opportunity to rethink how insurance agencies operate. Quandri is at the cutting edge of this change, delivering transformation to the entire insurance experience one process at a time through a deep understanding of insurance workflows, systems, and data, paired with deep technical capabilities and proprietary models. We're making insurance better for policyholders, while helping brokerages deliver better client service, grow faster, and harness AI so they control the future of insurance distribution. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

jobs.title: Client Partner ANZ
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. Spotify is seeking a talented and dynamic individual to join the team as a Contractor - Client Partner based in Sydney. This role will be responsible for driving revenue growth and building long-term relationships with key advertising clients and agencies. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify. Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

jobs.title: Client Partner, Emerging & Scaled
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We're looking for a Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled Sales team, one of the fastest-growing teams within Spotify Advertising. In this role, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, serving as a trusted advisor who understands their business goals and delivers advertising solutions that drive measurable impact. You'll combine strategic thinking, commercial expertise, and relationship management to develop long-term partnerships while helping advertisers unlock the full value of Spotify's advertising platform. If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer - Backstage
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Fullstack Web Engineer to join the Backstage team, passionate about crafting the best developer experience for millions of developers in the software industry. Leveraging our thriving open-source developer experience platform, Backstage, our teams are delivering high-impact external commercial products that truly up-level the industry standard of developer experience. Whether it’s a seasoned tech company that wants to build an internal developer portal using Backstage, or smaller companies that just want to quickly and easily increase developer satisfaction, or anything in between - our squads are shipping solutions that meet platform engineering needs all across the industry. About the team You will join the Backstage Product Area where you will help play an instrumental role in improving the experience of developers at our customer companies, in our fast-growing open-source community, and at Spotify internally. If you want to make a direct impact in helping Spotify become the industry leader in developer experience, this is the role for you.

jobs.title: Growth Lead - Japan
jobs.description_text: Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets. Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

jobs.title: Head of Markets Strategy & Operations, Japan
jobs.description_text: The Markets team is responsible for managing Spotify’s regions and their performance across all business-relevant metrics. Our team consists of regional Managing Directors and Market Strategy & Operation Managers (MSO). We are looking for a strategic, analytically-driven and open-minded character to support our efforts in Japan. As Head of Market Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for strategic direction based on business analysis and insights; business planning; regional operating processes; and managing cross-functional projects by building strong relationships across the company. In this position, you will work closely with global stakeholder, local functional leadership and report to the Managing Director, Japan

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Core Experience Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. The Core Experience team builds the foundations that make Spotify feel connected, intuitive, and consistent wherever people listen. From Playlists to shared product capabilities, we help teams across Spotify create experiences that millions of listeners use every day. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape the future of these platforms. You'll set product direction, bring teams together around shared priorities, and help create the capabilities that make great listening experiences possible at scale. This is an opportunity to influence how Spotify's products evolve while making a meaningful impact on listeners and creators around the world.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Format Foundations
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description_text: Every great Spotify experience starts with access. From creating an account to signing in and managing your identity, these foundational moments shape how millions of people connect with the music, podcasts, and content they love. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our User Platform team and help make these experiences simpler, smarter, and more delightful. You'll work at the intersection of design, product, and engineering, tackling complex challenges across authentication, account management, and emerging AI-powered experiences. This is an opportunity to bring exceptional craft to essential user journeys, explore new technologies, and shape experiences that reach millions of people. We value designers who are curious, hands-on, collaborative, and excited to turn ambitious ideas into beautifully executed products.

jobs.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success. Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify's consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. You'll lead a senior-heavy group of 10–12 machine learning engineers, including Staff engineers, who team up dynamically to solve high-priority business problems while staying deep in content understanding (audio, video and text). This is a player-coach role with a strong strategic remit: you'll shape where the group goes next, grow our audio understanding expertise over the long term, and help the team scale through thoughtful, practical use of AI in everyday engineering work.
